page_title: RBL 4-0 AUG | RB Leipzig v Augsburg 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
90' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
89' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig).

88' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) pounces on the cross and fires in a shot on goal from close range, but Nediljko Labrovic is alert and makes a decent save. RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
84' That will be all from Benjamin Sesko who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig).
84' Marco Rose prepares a substitution. Castello Lukeba is replaced by El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig).
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Daniel Siebert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Augsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Phillip Tietz trots off the pitch and is replaced by Yusuf Kabadayi (Augsburg).
78' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
75' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) replacing David Raum.
75' Substitution. Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig) has come on for Amadou Haidara.
74' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
70' A dangerous towering header by Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
70' RB Leipzig force a corner. They send men into the box.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marius Wolf leaves the pitch and Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) comes on.
68' Jess Thorup decides to make a substitution. Elvis Rexhbecaj will be replaced by Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg).
65' Here's the change. Antonio Nusa leaves the pitch and Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) comes on as a substitute.
63' RB Leipzig take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
63' RB Leipzig can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball goes out of play. RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.

62' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Nediljko Labrovic shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
58' The game has come to an end for Keven Schlotterbeck. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg).
58' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Steve Mounie (Augsburg) replaces Ruben Vargas.
57' 4 - 0 Goal! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes inside the right post. It's 4:0.
57' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but it's cleared.
55' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
55' RB Leipzig take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
55' David Raum (RB Leipzig) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
53' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniel Siebert blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to RB Leipzig.
52' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
46' 3 - 0 Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
46' The whistle blows and Daniel Siebert starts the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' RB Leipzig work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
42' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) picks up a yellow card.

42' What a wasted opportunity by Lois Openda (RB Leipzig)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the right side of the goal, but Nediljko Labrovic makes an astonishing save to thwart him. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
40' A great run from Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the right post.
39' A corner kick by Augsburg is thwarted by the well prepared Peter Gulacsi (RB Leipzig).
39' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
38' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Augsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
36' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
36' Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
32' A pass by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The linesman signals a throw-in for Augsburg.
31' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
28' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

27' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom left corner, but Peter Gulacsi pulls off a superb save. The ball goes out of play. Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.
26' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

26' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniel Siebert stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. It's a penalty! Augsburg have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
25' The ball is cleared after Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
22' The corner is swung in but Augsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
19' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
18' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
18' The game is interrupted now, Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
18' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' 2 - 0 Goal! David Raum is the provider and Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the top left corner from close in with his head. 2:0.
13' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Benjamin Sesko, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
11' 1 - 0 Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) receives a quality pass, makes a yard for himself and smashes a jaw-dropping long-range shot into the bottom left corner. What a remarkable goal!
7' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
6' RB Leipzig keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
5' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) jumps into a tackle and Daniel Siebert signals a foul.
3' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert will referee today's match.
